adHighCpu.description: Triggers high cpu load in the ad service

adManualGc.description: Triggers full manual garbage collections in the ad service

aiRunawayAgent.description: forces the agent to keep looping tool calls until it hits its recursion limit

aiSlowResponse.description: slow LLM responses in the agent service

auth.login-audit-log.description: Record login attempts in the auth.login_event table

cartFailure.description: Fail cart service n% of the time

cartMetricCardinalityOverflow.description: Adds the current trace ID to demo.cart.get_cart.latency to trigger SDK metric cardinality overflow. View it in the Self-Observability dashboard.

cartservice.add-db-call.description: Add database call to the cart service

emailMemoryLeak.description: Memory leak in the email service.

emitRawPii.description: Emit raw PII attributes (user.email, demo.payment.card_number, demo.payment.card_cvv) from checkout and payment for the collector redaction example. Not a failure scenario -- controls PII emission, independent of collector-side redaction which always runs.

failedReadinessProbe.description: readiness probe failure for cart service

frontend.login-link.description: Show the corporate login link in the header

frontendAllowsMastercard2Series.description: Simulates a frontend fix that starts letting 2-series Mastercards through to checkout. Payment's card validator still mis-types them as unknown and rejects them, so turning this on makes ~10% of load-generator checkouts fail with 'Credit card info is invalid'.

imageSlowLoad.description: slow loading images in the frontend

intlShippingSlowdown.description: Delays international shipping responses to simulate overseas shipping delay

kafkaConsumerDead.description: fraud-detection leaves the orders consumer group (unsubscribes and stops polling) while checkout keeps producing, so the group empties (members -> 0) and lag climbs against a zero-member group

kafkaQueueProblems.description: Throttles the fraud-detection consumer by sleeping N ms per consumed record (value = per-record delay in ms). Drains slower than checkout produces, so consumer lag climbs. Tune the delay live from this flag.

llmInaccurateResponse.description: LLM returns an inaccurate product summary for product ID L9ECAV7KIM

llmRateLimitError.description: LLM intermittently returns a rate limit error

loadGeneratorFloodHomepage.description: Flood the frontend with a large amount of requests.

paymentFailure.description: Fail payment service charge requests n%

paymentServiceRefundFailure.description: Fail payment service refund requests n%

productCatalogFailure.description: Fail product catalog service on a specific product

productCatalogLockContention.description: Trigger lock contention on the product catalog database

storechatConversationFailure.description: Simulate conversation store failures in store chat (1-in-5 when enabled)

storechatRefundBackupOrders.description: Drive store-chat refund traffic against a small fixed pool of customer emails so orders accumulate. lookup_orders has no pagination, so the tool result fed back to the model grows over time and inflates LLM input tokens per conversation.
